facts.value: Updates the shadow camera projection from four supplied bounds after asserting positive eye-to-interest distance. Ortho forwards bounds; frustum scales by near/distance. Perspective stores horizontal_extent/vertical_extent as aspect and atan2f(horizontal_extent,distance) directly as FOV. This does not establish that the resulting projection encloses the requested bounds.
facts.rationale: Replace guaranteed fitting with the literal implemented formulas.

evidence.why: Light perspective converts stored FOV degrees to radians.

facts.value: Provides shadow-camera projection parameter updates. The perspective path passes a radian atan2f result directly to a degree-valued FOV field, without conversion or doubling, and uses the maximum absolute horizontal extent for that angle. The reviewed fighter caller initializes non-perspective rectangle accumulation and has an orthographic fallback.
facts.rationale: Document the perspective-unit mismatch without claiming a corrected algorithm.

evidence.why: Light perspective converts stored FOV degrees to radians.

facts.value: Initializes a viewing-bounds accumulator by copying origin, computing eye displacement and its normalized direction, normalizing input up, and taking two cross products for right/up. Those cross products are not normalized afterward; right/up lengths depend on the supplied up-to-eye angle. Extents start at finite +/-F32_MAX sentinels.
facts.rationale: Avoid implying an orthonormal basis for arbitrary inputs.

facts.value: Writes origin, direction vectors, distance, perspective selector and inverted finite-extreme bounds. Only rect is asserted; position, interest and upvector must be valid. No zero-length or parallel-vector guard precedes normalization/cross products. Right/up need not be unit length. Validity check tests only strict bound ordering after later additions.
facts.rationale: Record basis validity preconditions and finite sentinels.

facts.value: Canonical static void makeMatrix(HSD_Shadow* shadow). Uses a Mtx (3-by-4) temporary for homogeneous texture projection and writes shadow->texture->mtx. Perspective/frustum rows encode projective texture coordinates, so this is not generally an ordinary affine world transform.
facts.rationale: Separate storage shape from projective semantics.

evidence.why: Perspective texture matrix third row is -Z.

facts.value: Selects light perspective, frustum or ortho construction; invalid mode asserts. Concatenates the resulting texture projection with the camera stored view matrix and writes texture->mtx. The Direct accessor does not refresh a dirty camera view, so callers must establish it before matrix generation. No local inverse or view rebuild occurs.
facts.rationale: Record reliance on precomputed camera view.

facts.value: Asserts the shadow graph, then skips all rendering when objects is NULL. Otherwise calls CObjSetCurrent but ignores its success result. Installs TEV/channel/PE setup and commits the existing texture-generator count, which is not explicitly zeroed here. Draws a white background, then intensity-colored casters using scissor(2,2,width-4,height-4), with no local minimum-size guard. Ends the camera pass. Does not test active or restore prior camera/state.
facts.rationale: Avoid guaranteed camera activation, zero texgen count, or safe inset for all positive dimensions.

evidence.why: Texgen count is committed/reset, while InitTev only resets TEV allocation.

facts.value: Allocates pooled storage and immediately zeroes it without checking that first allocation locally. Allocates a camera and shadow TObj/image descriptor, sets mapping scales/translations and zero intensity, image format0 and dimensions256x256, then camera viewport/scissor. The image descriptor allocator zeroes image_ptr, so no backing texture buffer is allocated by this function.
facts.rationale: Separate initialized descriptor from allocated render-target storage.

facts.value: Asserts shadow and positive u16 dimensions. Existing storage with equal dimensions returns without reapplying viewport/scissor. Otherwise frees old image first, computes I4 buffer size, asserts size>0, allocates replacement and stores dimensions and camera rectangles. It does not check the allocation result locally, change descriptor format, or refresh GX texture-copy configuration; HSD_ShadowInit supplies that separate step.

For a present camera, ref_DEC true triggers hsdDelete. ref_DEC returns true immediately for HSD_OBJ_NOREF, otherwise post-decrements and tests oldcount==0. Then clears caster list, unregisters texture if active, frees optional image payload, frees descriptor, calls HSD_TObjFree (virtual destroy only), and returns shadow storage to its allocator.
facts.rationale: Record exact reference and TObj cleanup conventions.

facts.value: StartRender draws only for nonempty caster lists, irrespective of active. EndRender has no caster-list or prior-render-success guard: it ensures backing storage, issues GXCopyTex with clear enabled, emits synchronization/invalidation calls and rebuilds the texture matrix. Activation controls material-registry membership independently. Caster insertion rejects null/duplicate pointers; deletion unreferences and removes one or all registrations.
facts.rationale: Distinguish draw, capture and activation conditions.
